name: Open-CUAK
description: Open-CUAK (Open Computer Use Agent Kit) is an open-source platform for building, running and managing browser automation agents. You can host it locally or use the hosted version, and it is a free alternative to OpenAI Operator.
why: Most computer-use agent demos stop at a single run. Open-CUAK focuses on reliability and on operating many browser agents side by side, with a self-hostable stack and documentation at https://docs.aident.ai. It is a practical starting point for teams that want open-source browser automation agents they can run themselves.
